name: UDA
description: UDA is a benchmark suite for retrieval-augmented generation in real-world document analysis, featuring 2,965 documents and 29,590 expert-annotated Q&A pairs across multiple domains and query types. It evaluates LLM and RAG-based solutions on unstructured, lengthy, and complex documents such as academic literature and financial reports.
reputation: A newer benchmark in the RAG/document-analysis space that is gaining attention for its large-scale, expert-annotated real-world document set.
notes: Focuses on real-world unstructured documents in HTML and PDF formats; highlights importance of data parsing and retrieval.
